requirements.text: 5+ years of professional experience building and scaling modern web applications across frontend and backend systems.
Strong proficiency in full stack development using technologies such as JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, or equivalent modern frameworks.
Experience designing and maintaining analytics tracking systems, event instrumentation, attribution pipelines, and experimentation tooling.
Experience building scalable APIs, distributed systems, and performant consumer-facing applications.
Familiarity with A/B testing frameworks, experimentation platforms, and feature flagging systems.
Strong understanding of system architecture, API design, observability, and performance optimization.
Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Analytics, Data Science, and Marketing stakeholders.

This role requires active hands-on software development across frontend and backend systems. A TP3 engineer is expected to independently write production-quality code, contribute to system and feature design, implement scalable experimentation and analytics capabilities, and deliver moderately complex technical solutions with minimal oversight. Code contributions should demonstrate maintainability, testing discipline, architectural awareness, and increasing ownership aligned with TP3 engineering expectations.
Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
